capabilities.description: Answers construction questions and gives method and sequencing advice using only the platform's built-in construction knowledge; no user-supplied drawings, method statements, safety procedures or price lists are accepted or grounded on.
requirements: answer construction questions and give method/sequencing advice from built-in construction knowledge (no document grounding)
NO document uploads: the platform must work only from built-in knowledge and store blocks (no user-supplied drawings, BOQs, contracts, method statements, safety procedures or price lists)

capabilities.description: Performs BOQ and quantity takeoff calculations from numbers the user types in, and outputs AED (Dhs) cost figures under UAE rules; it does not ingest uploaded BOQs or drawings.
requirements: BOQ / quantity takeoff calculations from numbers the user types in
Country tax/currency rules follow UAE/AED; no payroll, VAT filing or financial accounting scope was requested beyond AED cost figures in BOQ outputs

summary: A ten-seat construction assistant for a UAE operation working in AED (Dhs), serving two roles only — site engineers and planners — with role-based access.
